title: (Ir)rationality and Cognitive Biases in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates the rational reasoning capabilities of LLMs using classic cognitive psychology tasks (like the Wason task and Linda problem). While it mentions ethics and societal norms in the literature review and discusses how safety-alignment prompts (ethical refusals) impact model performance, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component of the research.
